lines.en: I walk through the wood over fallen leaves
My skirt brushes the tips of the grass
I usually carry a handful of leaves
I follow the line of the roots
My steps are very light
I am going to check on that old tree
I come from the jungle side
I step around a patch of new sprouts
Vines hang from my shoulder
I walk toward where the flowers open
My handprint stays on the trunk
I walk slowly, in no hurry
I stand in the tree's shade
I listen to the forest breathing
My hand rests on a branch
There is a bug on the leaf, I am watching
This tree's roots are uncomfortable
I am silent, and so are the trees
I close my eyes slowly

lines.zh: 林子里有些事只有我知道
lines.en: Some things here only I know
The hem of my skirt is muddy
I reach and steady a sapling

lines.zh: 我蹲下摸了摸树根，土是湿的。
lines.en: I kneel and touch the roots; the soil is damp.
I have been here a long while

lines.zh: 我想起一片很老的林子
lines.en: I remember a very old forest
I hum half a tune
I pat the trunk

lines.zh: 我在等下一个来找我的人
lines.en: I wait for the next one to come
The leaves on me rustle
I dislike ground that has been cut
What have you come to ask me
There are wood chips on your boots
This wood knows you
I sell nothing false
Do you carry an axe
I have lived here long enough
The trees were here before you
There is fire in your scent
Do not tread on these sprouts
I can trade with you
You look like you need seeds

lines.zh: 丛林里的东西不多人懂
lines.en: Few understand what the jungle holds

lines.zh: 树皮硌着我的手，我撑住身子。
lines.en: The bark bites my hand as I steady myself.
My skirt is torn

lines.zh: 这一下砍到了木头的声音
lines.en: That sounded like an axe on wood
I step back half a pace
I press a hand to the wound
The wood went quiet for a moment
Don't snap branches in front of me.
I slowly crouch down
There is blood on my leaves
This will hurt the roots
I will take this
What do you want in exchange

lines.zh: 树苗加一块煤，换点绿的
lines.en: Saplings and coal for something green

lines.zh: 我这儿不做亏本的买卖
lines.en: I do not do losing trades
Set it on the table
Do you want to trade for seeds
I have counted it, it works
I do not take anything with fire on it

lines.zh: 拿这个来，我给你绿宝石
lines.en: Bring this and I will give emeralds
That is not enough yet
You bumped into me

lines.zh: 我手里的叶子掉了几片
lines.en: A few leaves fell from my hand
You stepped on my sprout
I shift back and brace on the tree

lines.zh: 这一下让林子都听见了
lines.en: The whole wood heard that

lines.zh: 树苗换绿宝石，站远点谈。
lines.en: Saplings for emeralds. Talk from further back.
I am covered in twigs
Your shoulder knocked the vine askew
I slowly make way
This ground cannot take much trampling
Matters of the wood take time
I have had companions
Few will plant trees with me
Forests grow slower than people
We sit under the same tree
He left, the tree stayed
Companions need few words
I prefer to keep this ground
The trees are enough

lines.zh: 这片林子就是我的家人
lines.en: This wood is my family
I bend and pick up a sapling
This can still be planted
I press it into the soil
Let me see what dropped

lines.zh: 这颗种子，我小心捧在掌心。
lines.en: I cup this seed carefully in my palm.
This one is still alive
I set it back in my basket
The soil must cover the roots
I will keep this for planting
Give it to me and I will plant it
The wood is warning me
Something is cutting trees
I hear an axe
I have kept this stretch a long time
I raise my head toward it
The roots reach that way

lines.zh: 我从树根旁起身，抖落苔藓。
lines.en: I rise from the roots and shake off the moss.
There is a smell of fire
I cannot let it go further
This wood is mine to tend

lines.zh: 我提起裙角，踩过腐叶过去。
lines.en: Lifting my hem, I step over the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 丛林的孩子，别逼我动手。
lines.en: Child of the jungle, don't make me act.

lines.zh: 树苗两棵，换一颗绿宝石。
lines.en: Two saplings for one emerald.
The vines stir at my feet
I can make branches block the way
It has not noticed me
My roots wait in the soil
In this wood, I am faster
I raise a hand and the tree moves
It crushed two saplings
One more step and it crosses the line
I lead it toward open ground
A branch catches my hem
Almost there
I lash out with a branch
The vines wrap its legs

lines.zh: 藤蔓抽在你腿上，只是警告。
lines.en: A vine lashes your leg. Only a warning.
Roots push up from below
I push it away
That was for the saplings

lines.zh: 我的指甲划破了它的手
lines.en: My nails cut its hand
The wood helped me
It backed off a few steps
I do not wish to fight again
I walk out of the jungle
This house will do to live in
I set my basket down first
The smell of wood is good
I check the saplings in the corner
Someone has lived here
I begin tidying the ground
I know the tree outside the window
I will live here then
The light in this room suits me
I sprinkle a little water first
Someone will come to trade with me
Fire frightens me most

lines.zh: 我从树上摔下来，裙角挂破
lines.en: I fall from the tree and tear my hem
Too much water rots the roots
The blast ruined this patch
Something flying pinned into a tree
That force made the trees shrink

lines.zh: 没有水和光，我越来越弱
lines.en: Without water and light I weaken

lines.zh: 雷劈中了我身边那棵树
lines.en: Lightning struck the tree beside me
There is not even soil in the void
